verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's simulations let users replay historical tickets and synthetic or adversarial scenarios in bulk and compare outcomes before deploying a workflow change. AI-native users can trigger these runs from an assistant via the MCP server (e.g. /lorikeet:create-simulations, "Run simulations"). However, nothing documents a separate sandbox or staging environment or test credentials, and simulations draw on real tickets. Direct tool testing (e.g. get-order-status with a real order ID) may call live integrations, so isolation from production data is only implied. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/staging environment, documentation that simulations and tool tests do not read or write production systems, mock/test-mode integrations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
